newsitem.title: POLAND: S&P gives Polish Krakow long-term zloty debt BBB+.
newsitem.headline: S&P gives Polish Krakow long-term zloty debt BBB+.

text.p: Standard & Poors gave the Polish city of Krakow a long-term domestic currency debt rating of BBB+ with a stable forecast, a city official said on Tuesday.
S&P also gave Krakow a BBB- long-term foreign currency rating with a positive forecast -- the same rating the agency gave Poland's sovereign debt earlier in 1997.
A Krakow deputy president also told a news conference the city planned to borrow 100 million Ecu from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) in 1998.
"The board of the city of Krakow plans to write into next year's budget a 100 million Ecu loan from EBRD for financing the construction of a fast tramline," Krzysztof Gorlich said.
